title: Universal Life Insurance Relationship Pricing Note: Deferred Fixed Annuities Household Share of the Overloan Protection Charge
content:
**Pricing clause.** The share of the overloan protection charge paid on an Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance policy follows the owner's active Ashgrove deferred fixed annuity. An owner whose active deferred fixed annuity carries a contract value of at least **$50000** (the household large value) pays the large household share, **90%** (0.90) of the charge; an owner whose active deferred fixed annuity carries a smaller contract value pays the small household share, **95%** (0.95); an owner with no active deferred fixed annuity pays the whole charge. The household share multiplies the charge before it is rounded to the cent.

**Which holding is read?** A Deferred Fixed Annuities contract (an Ashgrove Flexible Premium Deferred Annuity or an Ashgrove SecureRate contract) owned by the same owner as the universal life policy, whose status is active. The figure read is the contract value shown on that annuity contract.

**What if the annuity is not active?** A surrendered, annuitized or otherwise inactive contract is not an active deferred fixed annuity, and the owner pays the whole charge unless another active one is held.

**Does an annuity owned by another person count?** No; it is not the owner's holding.

**Hypothetical readings.**

| Owner's Deferred Fixed Annuities contract | Status | Contract value | Household share |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ashgrove SecureRate 5 | Active | $50000.00 | 90% |
| Ashgrove Flexible Premium Deferred Annuity | Active | $49999.99 | 95% |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 7 | Surrendered | not read | Whole charge |
| None held | not applicable | not applicable | Whole charge |

A charge of $7000.0000 before the share becomes $6300.0000 at 90% and $6650.0000 at 95%.
